# VidCuts

> VidCuts is an ultra-fast, 100% private in-browser multimedia and document workspace. Cut videos, convert 16:9 to 9:16 Shorts with promo cards, edit photos, process 32 PDF tools & generate custom QR codes — 0 bytes uploaded to external servers.

VidCuts operates completely client-side in the user's web browser using WebAssembly (FFmpeg WASM), HTML5 Canvas, and modern Web APIs. All video, audio, image, and PDF files remain strictly on the user's local device with zero cloud storage or server processing.

## Core Tools
- [VidCuts Home](https://www.vidcuts.online/): All-in-one in-browser multimedia and document studio.
- [Video Cutter & Splitter](https://www.vidcuts.online/video-cutter/): Split videos by piece count, duration (30s, 60s), or exact minute timestamps with lossless stream copy and 16:9 to 9:16 Shorts conversion.
- [Media Tools & Audio Extractor](https://www.vidcuts.online/media-tools/): Download videos from direct URLs, extract lossless audio to MP3/AAC, and mute/remove audio streams.
- [Image Studio & Shape Cropper](https://www.vidcuts.online/image-tools/): Crop photos to social aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 9:16) and mask into 8 geometric shapes with transparent PNG export.
- [32 Client-Side PDF Tools](https://www.vidcuts.online/pdf-tools/): Merge, split, compress, watermark, rotate, page number, unlock, and AES-256 encrypt documents.
- [Vector QR Code Studio](https://www.vidcuts.online/qr-code-generator/): Custom vector QR code generator with 15 protocols, logo embeds with 9-position alignment, and camera scanner.
- [Local Files Manager](https://www.vidcuts.online/file-tools/): In-browser session media manager with direct folder export (File System Access API) and ZIP archiving.
